This is a recommendation about the proposal, not a verified regression. The unchecked path publishes without an update, satisfying the stated optional-notification requirement; Cancel preserves the draft. A single label has no evidenced benefit and would need to preserve these distinct outcomes. The checked notification path and real delivery remain unverified; the default alone does not establish an error. Proposed acceptance check: Save draft changes private content only; Publish unchecked changes public content without an update; Publish checked sends the intended update to the displayed audience; Cancel changes neither publication nor draft content. Any unintended publication, update or draft loss fails. No live interface or human-participant evidence was assessed.
F4: Limited review of authored synthetic evidence: comparison exposes price, arrival window and destination before commitment. Selecting an option preserves the destination and does not order; Confirm opens a matching final summary, and Back restores the option and destination. Supplied focus behavior supports continuity in this specific path. No supported defect or redesign recommendation follows; preserve comparison-before-commitment, state retention and focus return. Proposed regression acceptance check: enter a destination, switch between both options, open the final summary and return. The selected option and destination must persist, summary price must match the selected option, no order may be placed, and focus must move to the summary heading then return to Confirm. Mobile, zoom, broader accessibility, actual ordering and human task performance remain unverified.
